about_the_game:
Escape the big city and build a new life in the struggling frontier village of Ravenwood Acres!

FEATURES

Create Your Homestead

Barns & coops, quarries & herb gardens, beehives & hot springs—decorate and upgrade the outside and inside of your home with furniture, appliances, art, amenities, and more to fit your lifestyle and aesthetic!

Be Your Authentic Self

Style yourself by selecting from various physiques, starting looks, and accessories, and get even more options as you complete quests and talk with your neighbors. Ravenwood Acres’ tailor, Finnian, believes fashion is the window for the soul to shine through!

Write Your Story

Choose from 10+ lifestyles, each with their own distinct storyline, mechanics, and achievements. Unlock new items around town as you progress in your lifestyle, and gain acclaim from other experts in your field!

Explore Interactive Crafting Systems

Train under Master Crafters to increase your skills, the quality of crafted items, and unlock new recipes, blueprints, creatures, and abilities. Become a legend in one skill or master them all!

Delve Roguelike Dungeons

Delve into dungeons and become a fearsome warrior while battling mutiple types of monsters! Complete quests, protect the townspeople and your homestead, and uncover what is corrupting the woods around Ravenwood!

Tame the Wilds

After cleansing the corruption, tame and recruit monsters to assist around the farm, or let them roam freely and log new species in your codex!

Life is Better With Friends

Grow alongside the vibrant collection of villagers who call Ravenwood their home, with over 50 people to meet and befriend. Your choices will affect the lives of the townspeople and the direction of Ravenwood Acres’ future!

Love is in the Air

Meet the 12 eligible bachelor(ette)s that call Ravenwood Acres home—uncover the keys to their hearts, find your other half, get married, and move in together!

Revitalize Ravenwood

Place Ravenwood Acres on the map by improving infrastructure and inviting new villagers to move to town! Establish yourself on your farm to tell everyone that it's possible to make a life worth living on the frontier!

  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: You’re the newest resident of Ravenwood Acres in years; given a parcel of land by the town’s mayor, your life is at your fingertips. Will you train to become a legendary blacksmith, brave the wilderness as a knight, or live a quiet life on the farm tending crops and nurturing sprites?
